lines.en: Hooves tap, a soft rustle.

lines.zh: 皮肤下脉络涌动，肌肉紧绷。
lines.en: Veins pulse under skin, muscles tense.
Heavy footsteps, a low moan.
Nostrils flare, sniffing the air.
Steps hurried, hunger driving.

lines.zh: 蹄子轻敲地面，寻找食物。
lines.en: Hooves tap the ground, seeking sustenance.
Eyes gleam as it walks.

lines.zh: 蹄声踏过枯叶，沙沙作响。
lines.en: Hooves crackle over dry leaves.
Steps firm, traversing the forest.

lines.zh: 蹄声渐远，消失在丛林中。
lines.en: Hooves fade, disappearing into the forest.

lines.zh: 蹄子踩过化石层，沙沙作响。
lines.en: Hooves crunch across the fossil bed.

lines.zh: 我沿着考古坑边慢慢走。
lines.en: I trudge along the edge of the dig site.

lines.zh: 金粒在指缝里叮当作响。
lines.en: Gold nuggets clink between my fingers.

lines.zh: 僵尸猪灵的步子不快不慢。
lines.en: An undead piglin walks at his own pace.
Staring up at the sky, eyes unfocused.
Standing still, waiting for an opportunity.
Casually scanning its surroundings.
Chewing unknown grass.
Head lowered in thought, pondering.
Standing quietly, as if listening.

lines.zh: 低头整理着身上的装备。
lines.en: Adjusting its gear, head down.
Stretching lazily.
Surveying its surroundings, looking for companions.

lines.zh: 静静地站了一会儿，似乎有所发现。
lines.en: Standing quietly for a while, seemingly noticing something.
I count my ribs; one is missing.

lines.zh: 我在阴处数自己的指骨。
lines.en: I count my own finger bones in the shade.

lines.zh: 我蹲在化石旁发了一会儿呆。
lines.en: I squat by a fossil and stare at nothing.
My gold helm sits crooked; I straighten it.
Sharp eyes fix on the player.

lines.zh: 转头注视玩家，眼神闪烁。
lines.en: Head turns, eyes flicker with intent.

lines.zh: 突然一跃而起，向玩家靠近。
lines.en: Leaps to its feet, moving towards the player.

lines.zh: 我眼睛亮，可我的掉落表是干净的。
lines.en: My eyes glow, but my loot table is clean.

lines.zh: 迅速跑动，想要接近玩家。
lines.en: Rushes forward, trying to get closer.

lines.zh: 停下脚步，眼神充满敌意。
lines.en: Stops, eyes filled with hostility.

lines.zh: 你的背包里有金子吗，我不抢。
lines.en: Is there gold in your pack? I will not take it.

lines.zh: 靠近玩家，眼神中满是渴望。
lines.en: Creeps closer, eyes full of desire.

lines.zh: 突然消失在树林中，踪影全无。
lines.en: Vanishes into the woods, leaving no trace.

lines.zh: 眼神中闪过犹豫，但仍紧盯着玩家。
lines.en: Eyes waver, but remain fixed on the player.

lines.zh: 我不打你，只是这样看着。
lines.en: I won't hit you — I'll just watch.
I tilt my head at you, harmless.

lines.zh: 你的镐子挖到我的同类了吗？
lines.en: Did your pick strike one of my kin?

lines.zh: 别举剑，我只想看看你的金子。
lines.en: Lower the sword; I only want a look at your gold.

lines.zh: 你站远些，我闻着不舒服。
lines.en: Stand back a bit, your scent unsettles me.

lines.zh: 你也在挖化石？带我一个。
lines.en: Digging fossils too? Take me along.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的背包，不是盯着你。
lines.en: I stare at your pack, not at you.

lines.zh: 你笑什么？我这张脸很奇怪吗？
lines.en: What are you laughing at? Is my face so strange?
My skin's cracking!
My bones hurt!
The piglin's snout got bumped.
Rotten flesh will not close this gash!
My wings are broken!
I'm bitten!
Deep wounds!
I'm dying!
So weak!

lines.zh: 我扶着墙，腐肉也吃不下了。
lines.en: I'm against the wall and can't even eat rotten flesh.

lines.zh: 你手中的胡萝卜太诱人了！
lines.en: That carrot in your hand looks too good!

lines.zh: 别走，我还想和你换点东西。
lines.en: Do not go — I still want to trade with you.

lines.zh: 别走开，我还想再聊会儿！
lines.en: Don't go, I want to chat some more!

lines.zh: 你的背包里一定有很多好东西！
lines.en: Your backpack must have good stuff!

lines.zh: 食物对我来说就是生命！
lines.en: Food is life to me!

lines.zh: 你手上的苹果是我的啦！
lines.en: That apple is mine!

lines.zh: 这附近的果实都归我了！
lines.en: All the fruits around here are mine!

lines.zh: 来吧，分享一些你的食物吧！
lines.en: Share some food with me!
Don't be afraid, I won't hurt you!
Food brings us closer!
Oops, we bumped into each other!
Don't run, I won't attack you!
You're quick!

lines.zh: 我这一身腐皮撞上你的护腿。
lines.en: My rotting hide bumps against your leggings.
Don't be scared, I'm just passing by!
A rotten-flesh friend. One nudge.
I bumped into you, sorry!
Don't be scared, it's just a mistake!
You're so agile!

lines.zh: 我们不小心撞到了一起！
lines.en: We accidentally bumped into each other!
I'm up for a mate!
Find a mate, we coexist!

lines.zh: 我不抢你的金，只想和你搭个伴。
lines.en: I will not take your gold; I only want to keep you company.
Find a mate, share food!
Find a mate, warm each other!
I'm willing to live with you!
Find a mate, share happiness!
Find a mate, no longer alone!
I'm willing to share everything with you!
Find a mate, share the future!

lines.zh: 摸了摸它的鬃毛，发出咕噜声。
lines.en: Grumbled when touched its mane.

lines.zh: 咬了一口，享受地叫了一声。
lines.en: Chomped and let out a contented sound.

lines.zh: 咀嚼着树叶，发出沙沙声。
lines.en: Chewed leaves, making rustling noises.
Scattered through food, making rustling noises.
Gurgled when eating mushrooms.
Crunched on fruits, making crackling noises.

lines.zh: 捡起掉落的果实，发出咕噜声。
lines.en: Gurgled when picking up fallen fruits.

lines.zh: 吃下一块面包，发出咕噜声。
lines.en: Gurgled after eating a bread slice.
Crunched on bones, making crackling noises.

lines.zh: 捡起盔甲碎片，发出轻响。
lines.en: Made a light noise when picking up armor pieces.
Growled when spotting you.
Hissed when staring at you.
Gurgled when spotting food.
Hissed when looking at you.
Let out a soft growl when noticing you.
Hissed when locking on you.
Gurgled when finding you.
Hissed when targeting you.

lines.zh: 发现了目标，发出咕噜声。
lines.en: Gurgled when spotting the target.
Hissed when keeping an eye on you.

lines.zh: 我嗅到活物的热气，抬起头。
lines.en: I catch the heat of a living thing and look up.

lines.zh: 那边有人，我慢慢转过身。
lines.en: Someone is over there; I turn slowly.

lines.zh: 耳朵一动，我听见脚步了。
lines.en: My ear twitches, I heard footsteps.

lines.zh: 我朝你的方向哼了一声。
lines.en: I grunt toward where you stand.
A living one is near; I keep an eye out.

lines.zh: 我抬起鼻子，闻到了铁与汗。
lines.en: I raise my snout and smell iron and sweat.

lines.zh: 朝你吹了一口气，发出嘶嘶声。
lines.en: Hissed after blowing air at you.

lines.zh: 用蹄子指向你，发出嘶嘶声。
lines.en: Pointed at you with hooves, hissing.
Hissed and advanced toward you.
Hissed and bit at you.
Hissed and stared at you.
Hissed and charged forward.
Hissed and lunged at you.
Hissed, trying to pull you.
Hissed, trying to push you.
Hissed, trying to bite you.

lines.zh: 我挡在化石坑前，不让开。
lines.en: I block the fossil pit and will not move.

lines.zh: 你再靠近一步，我就哼一声。
lines.en: One more step and I will grunt at you.
I lay my gold sword across my chest.

lines.zh: 你的剑柄在晃，我鼻子里全是铁味。
lines.en: Your sword hilt sways and my snout is full of iron.

lines.zh: 我们之间保持三步距离。
lines.en: Three steps between us, no closer.
I plant my feet and wait for you to move first.

lines.zh: 你要是动手，我也不客气。
lines.en: If you swing first, I will answer.

lines.zh: 我压低鼻息，盯着你的剑。
lines.en: I lower my snort and watch your blade.
Grab you with claws!

lines.zh: 我这一口只是想让你退开。
lines.en: This bite is only meant to push you back.
Kick your armor to pieces!
Rip you apart with fangs!
Hook you with claws!
Trample your corpse!
Butterfly stomp you!
Scratch you with claws!
Sink fangs into you!
Hook and drag you!
You struck first, don't blame me!
Gold blade sweeps wide, back off!
I shove you off with my shoulder plate!
My tusks bite only the one holding a sword!
This one is repayment for yours!
Hooves stamp the ground and drive you back!

lines.zh: 我不抢你的金，只是路过。
lines.en: I am not after your gold, only passing.
Rise from ruins!

lines.zh: 我从废弃矿井的支架后走出来。
lines.en: I step out from behind a mineshaft support.
Step out of shadows!
Spawn under night!
Spawn from rubble!
Rise from darkness!
Spawn in labyrinth!
Spawn in tunnels!
Spawn in mines!
I sit up out of the soul sand.

lines.zh: 腐肉重新长回我的骨头。
lines.en: Rot knits itself back onto my bones.
The gold helm gleams first, then I open my eyes.

lines.zh: 我在下界废墟里站直身子。
lines.en: I straighten up in the Nether ruins.

lines.zh: 一阵硫磺味，我就出现了。
lines.en: A whiff of sulfur, and here I am.

lines.zh: 我的蹄子先落地，身体后到。
lines.en: My hooves land first, the rest of me follows.

lines.zh: 我从化石层的缝隙爬出。
lines.en: I crawl out of a seam in the fossil layer.

lines.zh: 死人堆里，我又站起来了。
lines.en: Out of the pile of dead, I rise again.
Lava light falls across my face.

lines.zh: 我用鼻子拱开碎石，走了出来。
lines.en: I nudge the rubble aside with my snout and walk out.

lines.zh: 我身上的皮，早就烧焦了。
lines.en: The hide on my body charred long ago.

lines.zh: 脚下一空，我从石阶滚下来！
lines.en: The stone gave way and I rolled down the steps!
My rotten flesh is soaked — I can't breathe!

lines.zh: 炸开的碎石擦过我的耳朵！
lines.en: Flying rubble grazes my ear!

lines.zh: 我不抢金子，你射我做什么？
lines.en: I do not take gold. Why shoot me?

lines.zh: 紫色的光钻进腐肉里，很凉！
lines.en: Purple light seeps into my rotten flesh, cold!
My belly is empty, nothing but bones...

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我的金甲发烫。
lines.en: Lightning struck; my gold armor burns.

lines.zh: 脚下的砖没了，我一直在掉！
lines.en: The floor tiles are gone and I keep falling!
